delete.description:
Use this endpoint to delete a customer with Meld and/or with any of the service providers it is linked to. This endpoint should only be used for customers using the Bank-Linking stack, as it is not yet compatible with the Payments or Crypto stack. If a customer is deleted that is linked to a Payments or Crypto service provider customer, it will still be deleted with Meld, but not with the provider.

***Note:*** For customers using the Bank-Linking stack, this will delete all of the customer's connections and financial accounts as well.

parameters.name: Meld-Version
parameters.description: Dated API version to use for this request, e.g. `2026-02-03`.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: Meld generated unique identifier for your customer. This should be used to track customer activity.

parameters.name: serviceProviders
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of service providers. If present, the customer will ***only*** be deleted with these specified service provider(s), but the Meld customer will remain active. This can be useful for when service providers impose restrictions on the number of customers allowed in their sandbox/development environments. In such cases, you may only want to delete the customer with that provider, but maintain it for other providers it is connected to, if any. If this parameter is absent, then the customer will be deleted with all the service providers it is linked to and the Meld customer will be deleted as well.

***Note:*** Currently, this endpoint only supports deleting [Bank-Linking service provider](https://docs.meld.io/docs/bank-linking-supported-service-providers) customers. Therefore, Payments/Crypto service providers ***should not*** be included.

***Note:*** Only one preference of each type can exist. To edit an existing preference, use the Update an account preference endpoint instead

accountLogoUrl.description: The path to the account's logo for displaying in the wizard

borderColor.description: The color of the border for the wizard

borderTextColor.description: The color of the text on the wizard border (i.e. 'Integrations powered by Meld.io')

buttonColor.description: The button color for the widget in light mode

buttonTextColor.description: The color of the Buy/Sell text on the CTA button

headlessOnrampsEnabled.description: Account-wide gate for the headless onramp endpoint (POST /crypto/order/headless). When true, the validator's WHITELABEL_NOT_ENABLED gate passes for any headless-eligible provider the account is provisioned for. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false (default-deny).

hideBackButton.description: Whether to hide the back button in the crypto widget. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

kycLevel1Enabled.description: Whether the account's customers may start KYC at level 1 (applicant data, no ID document or liveness) when their providers accept it. Set by Meld only. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

maxQuotes.description: The maximum number of quotes to return

meldFeeSchedule.description: Meld's own fee for this account, invoiced to the account and never deducted from the transfer. If a value is not set, Meld adds no fee of its own.

offrampEnabled.description: Should offramp behavior be enabled where supported. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

offrampKycMode.description: How headless offramp orders treat the customer's KYC. RELIANCE: the account relies on its own KYC of its users, so Meld places offramp orders with no Meld or provider KYC step and, where the provider needs a sender, sends as the account's configured corporate originator. Set by Meld only. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be STANDARD.

offrampSwapEnabled.description: Should offramp+swap behavior be enabled where supported. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

onrampEnabled.description: Should onramp behavior be enabled where supported. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

onrampSwapEnabled.description: Should onramp+swap behavior be enabled where supported. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

quoteBindingRequired.description: Whether headless offramp orders must be created from a quote: when true, quoteId, destinationAmount and refundWalletAddress are required on order creation. Set by Meld only. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

showAccountLogoOnTop.description: Should display account's logo in the top middle of widget border

standardPartnerFee.description: The standard preferred partner fee for this account.  This is informational rather than authoritative.

topServiceProviders.description: The top service provider's for the wizard quote screen

widgetUrlGenerationEnforced.description: Whether widget URL generation for this account must go through the backend. When true, any caller-supplied widget URL params are ignored and the URL is always generated server-side. Defaults to true for newly created accounts. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

enableCheckoutUnifiedKyc.description: Whether the Meld Checkout unified KYC + OTP flow is enabled for this account. If a value is not set, it is assumed to be false.

enableKycTokenImport.description: Whether the imported token will be used to import KYC applicant to Meld's KYC provider account (TRUE) or will be passed to network partners as is (FALSE)

percentBps.description: Fee in basis points of the gross fiat amount (10 = 0.10%)

type.description: Type of preference to create for this account

documentNumber.description: Identity document number (passport, licence or ID card). Optional. Banxa decides when it is required — historically on bank rails below roughly 400 USD-equivalent, and not requested at all since 2026-09-21 — so treat the eligibility response as the authority rather than assuming a rail or amount.

BanxaExtraKycDetails.description: Banxa enhanced-due-diligence answers and optional proof-of-address document

InitiateKycRequest.description: Request to initiate KYC for a customer with a given provider

mode.description: KYC initiation mode. Optional on POST, where it defaults to HOSTED_URL; required on PATCH

order.description: POST only: the order the customer is about to place

serviceProviderDetails.description: Provider-specific details required for the selected mode. Required when mode is TOKEN_IMPORT, null for HOSTED_URL

targetServiceProvider.description: The provider the customer is heading to. Meld verifies the customer at the level that provider needs, steps an existing applicant up to it, and shares the result when the provider takes a KYC share. POST only before Meld-Version 2026-11-01; on 2026-11-01 or later the same as naming it in targetServiceProviders

targetServiceProviders.description: Meld-Version 2026-11-01 or later: the providers the customer may use. Meld verifies at the highest level any of them needs and shares with each once its prerequisites are in; it never fails on them. Requires Meld-Version 2026-11-01 or later; older versions answer 400 KYC_TARGETS_NEED_MELD_VERSION.
